_comment: Manual status overrides for the raylib 6.0 parity report and conformance check. 'verified' lists raylib function names that a conformance/behavioral test exercises. 'aliases' maps a raylib name to a differently-named MeowyRender equivalent. 'platform_unavailable' maps a name to the reason it is genuinely not implementable on this backend (a documented no-op). 'intentional_noop' maps a name to why an empty/trivial body is the CORRECT implementation here (no work to do). 'intentional_difference' records documented behavioral notes for functions that ARE implemented. The conformance checker fails if any manifest function is a stub (empty/trivial-constant body) unless it appears in platform_unavailable or intentional_noop.

intentional_noop.UnloadVrStereoConfig: MeowyRender's VrStereoConfig is a plain value type holding matrices/vectors and owns no GPU resources (unlike raylib, which frees a distortion shader), so there is nothing to release.
intentional_noop.UpdateMusicStream: miniaudio services music streaming on its own audio thread, so no manual per-frame buffer refill is required for playback to continue; kept for raylib API parity.

intentional_difference.SetGamepadVibration: Implemented via SDL's gamepad subsystem (SDL3) on the desktop backend because GLFW exposes no haptics API. GLFW retains windowing/input; SDL initializes only SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD. The public (GLFW slot) index is mapped to the matching SDL controller by joystick GUID + connection order. Motors [0,1] map to SDL Uint16, duration is in seconds; zeros stop rumble. Requires SDL3 at build time (MEOWY_USE_SDL_GAMEPAD, ON by default); without it this is a documented no-op. Mapping/conversion/lifecycle are tested by gamepad_rumble_checks; physical motor movement is reported UNVERIFIED without a connected controller.
intentional_difference.GetMusicTimePlayed: Backed by miniaudio's ma_sound_get_time_in_milliseconds, which reports CUMULATIVE elapsed play time (keeps counting across loops and is not reset by SeekMusicStream), rather than raylib's position-within-track. Playback/seek still function; only the reported value's meaning differs.
intentional_difference.GetMusicTimeLength: For streamed Ogg Vorbis, miniaudio's stb_vorbis decoder cannot report total length without a full scan, so length may be 0 for .ogg music streams; WAV/FLAC/MP3 report length normally.
intentional_difference.CompressData: Emits RAW DEFLATE (no zlib wrapper), matching raylib's on-wire format: the stb zlib stream's 2-byte header and 4-byte adler32 trailer are stripped.
intentional_difference.DecompressData: Inflates raw DEFLATE (parse_header=0), matching raylib's CompressData output format.
intentional_difference.ComputeMD5: Returns a pointer to a static unsigned int[4] (raylib semantics); words are little-endian.
intentional_difference.ComputeSHA1: Returns a pointer to a static unsigned int[5] (raylib semantics); words are big-endian.
